timecoded_text_to_speech.text: Have you ever dreamed that you could dance like a beautiful ballerina or felt so happy
that you could sing like a fairy tale princess or wish that you could soar above the clouds?
Welcome to the Barbie Princess collection.
Six fairy tale DVDs filled with magic and adventure.
Barbie leads you on a dance through enchanted lands where you'll meet fantastic new friends,
fall in love, overcome danger and live happily ever after.
Barbie dances into your heart.
In her movie Barbie in the 12 dancing princesses.
Barbie and her sisters must uncover hidden secrets of a magical land in order to save their kingdom.
Together they learn that big or small, everyone can make a difference.
During Barbie in her first original princess fairy tale, Barbie and the magic of Pegasus,
she and her friends fly to a fantastical cloud kingdom in a magical adventure
as they prove there's always hope.
In her first ever movie musical, the princess and the popper, Barbie sings.
Together with her new twin best friend, Erica and their adorable cats,
they save the kingdom and find free love.
Journey to Swan Lake, where Barbie enters a world of love and enchantment
and learns that each of us is braver than we think.
With the longest, prettiest hair ever, Barbie stars in Rapunzel.
This is the one and discovers that love and imagination can change the world.
Barbie's thrilling adventure with the wooden knock cracker,
the Barbie movie that started it all, shows that if you were kind, clever and brave,
anything is possible.
Collect all of Barbie's animated adventures, Barbie in the knock cracker, Rapunzel, Swan Lake,
the princess and the popper, the magic of Pegasus, and Barbie in the 12 dancing princesses,
now available on DVD.
